seo.meta_description: PMHScribe is an AI scribe built for psychiatrists and PMHNPs. Specializes in medication management documentation with psychiatric-specific templates.

faqs.a: AI documentation tool designed specifically for psychiatric prescribers—psychiatrists, PMHNPs, and PAs. Focuses on medication management visits with templates built for psychiatric workflows.

faqs.q: How is PMHScribe different from general AI scribes?
faqs.a: PMHScribe is built for psychiatric prescribers, not general therapy. It emphasizes medication documentation: current meds, side effects, dosage changes, and response to treatment. Templates align with psychiatric billing requirements.
No. PMHScribe targets psychiatric prescribers—those doing medication management. Therapists should look at Upheal, Mentalyc, or Blueprint instead.

faqs.q: What note types does PMHScribe support?
faqs.a: Medication management notes, psychiatric evaluations, and follow-up visits. Templates include sections for psychiatric symptoms, medication review, side effects, and treatment planning.
Yes. HIPAA compliant with BAA available for healthcare providers.

faqs.q: How does PMHScribe compare to Talkiatry's MDHub?
faqs.a: Both target psychiatric prescribers. PMHScribe is a standalone product available to any practice, while MDHub is part of Talkiatry's integrated telepsychiatry platform. Choose PMHScribe if you want a standalone scribe for your existing practice.
